Uses of Package
com.jasonwjones.di

Packages that use com.jasonwjones.di
Package
Description
com.jasonwjones.di
Public client API for the unofficial Data Management (DM/AIF) REST service, a separate service from the main PBCS/Planning REST API used for jobs and application/dimension metadata that the Planning API doesn't expose.
com.jasonwjones.di.impl
Default implementation of the Data Management (DM/AIF) client API.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs
Root package for the PBJ client library.
com.jasonwjones.pbcs.util
Public utility classes for working with grids and plan type dimensions: printing and diffing data slices (GridPrinter, DataSliceDiff), walking a dimension hierarchy (PlanTypeWalker), and building test fixtures or sample connections (TextGridReader, PbcsClientUtils).
